    Read the state of a control service

    Source: R/control-client.R
    at_control_state.Rd

    Read the state of a control service

    Usage

    at_control_state(handle, call = rlang::caller_env())

    Arguments

    handle

    An at_control_handle.

    call

    The calling environment, for error reporting.

    Value

    The state snapshot (a list) with state_revision, event_cursor, queue, current (image, layers, ROI summaries, annotation revision), view, selection, staged, last_commit and status fields.

    See also

    Other control: at_control_capabilities(), at_control_close(), at_control_command(), at_control_connect(), at_control_events(), at_control_request_status(), at_control_start(), at_control_stop()
